answer: Make every identity grow its own quartz chain: each epoch it extends a memory-hard sequential proof (an Argon2-style hash chain needing 2 GB of RAM, unparallelisable, seeded by the epoch beacon and its own key). Votes count only from keys whose garden of unbroken links spans 30+ epochs. The chain is bound to one key, so it cannot be sold or copied to a clone; an onyx flag marks any key whose chain breaks and resets its tenure. A farm of n identities pays n machines of RAM-time every epoch, unpoolable.
